title: Positivity of the $q$-ary entropy
statement:
Let $\alpha$ be a finite alphabet with $q = \abs{\alpha}$ symbols, and let $p$ be a real number with $0 < p \le 1 - 1/q$. Then the $q$-ary entropy of $p$ is strictly positive:
\[
H_q(p) \;=\; p\log_q(q-1) - p\log_q p - (1-p)\log_q(1-p) \;>\; 0.
\]
hypotheses_covered: q equals the cardinality of the finite alphabet
